title: Revalidate authority at side-effect dispatch after pause or revocation
narrative: Authority is rechecked when a consequential action actually runs — not only at graph start, approval capture, or checkpoint creation. A paused graph resumed after revocation must not publish. Related: `fangore_insp_wake_reresolve`, `fangore_human_review_pending`, `fangore_insp_auth_epoch_resume`. Tracks MH-DOTS-02[^insp-dots-02].
implementation: `revalidate_before_effect` rechecks envelope expiry, the live authorization epoch, envelope grants, and access control. `GraphExecutor` calls it before every node whose `tool_phase` payload is `execute` (the default); observe/prepare nodes skip it. Hosts feed the live epoch through `executor.live_authorization_epoch`. A failed recheck fails the node as `revalidation_failed:<reason>` without invoking the runner.
validation: Harness `cli` `probe` loads `plans/effect_revalidation_check.yaml` (human-readable probe plan); hard expects on declared observation keys.
